value.title: Explicit style categories initialize valid parents and survive draft handoff
value.statement: A new object created by sketch, current location or walk may explicitly choose a concrete local style category before geometry. The dialog preserves its originating tool through recreation; walk ownership persists typed initial values atomically until geometry/form handoff, and cancelling a point category releases only the foreground point lock. Mixed forms are inspected without normalizing non-selector or empty bindings. Legacy and cascading selectors use canonical values and every valid stable-key parent filter; ambiguous tuples remain separate choices. Initial state never overwrites restored control state or existing objects, survives geometry and pre-launch form checkpoints, and never bypasses the normal Save gates.
